verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's homepage claims it can screen customers and streamline ongoing monitoring with customizable automation, so ongoing screening is a vendor-stated capability. Nothing in the evidence shows a per-customer control to turn that screening on or off; the 90-day pending case review is a related feature, not a screening toggle. Missing for 10: documented enable/disable control for ongoing screening per selected customer, first-party docs describing ongoing screening configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
